description: Estimate the total budget impact of adopting a new intervention over 1-5 years. Follows ISPOR Budget Impact Analysis good practice guidelines (Mauskopf 2007, Sullivan 2014). Computes year-by-year net cost to payer, including market share uptake, treatment displacement, and population growth. IMPORTANT: drug_cost_annual and comparator_cost_annual are required numeric inputs. If the user has not provided them, use your training knowledge of published list prices (NHS BNF/Drug Tariff for nhs perspective, WAC/AWP for us_payer) or the most recent NICE appraisal cost inputs as your best estimate — do NOT refuse to run the model. Flag any self-sourced prices in the output as 'estimated from published list price' and state the source.

ai_disclosure_level.description: AI assistance disclosure level. "off" = no disclosure; "standard" = default (model/tools/sources/date + human-review reminder); "submission" = adds ISPOR ELEVATE-GenAI citation. Default is tool-specific.

admin_cost_annual.description: Annual administration cost (applies to both arms). Default 0.

ae_cost_annual.description: Annual adverse event cost for intervention. Default 0.

comparator_ae_cost_annual.description: Annual adverse event cost for comparator. Default 0.

displacement.description: Existing treatments displaced by intervention (share of patients switching, cost saved)

drug_cost_annual.description: Annual drug acquisition cost for intervention

eligible_population.description: Number of eligible patients in Year 1

market_share.description: Expected market share of intervention by year (0-1). Missing years extrapolate from last defined.

monitoring_cost_annual.description: Annual monitoring cost for intervention. Default 0.

output_format.description: Use 'xlsx' for a structured Excel report with all inputs, year-by-year calculations, and audit trail in separate tabs. The workbook is a REPORT — editing cells does not re-run the model. Re-run by calling the tool again with modified parameters.

perspective.description: Payer perspective: 'nhs' (UK NHS), 'us_payer' (US commercial/Medicare), or 'societal' (broader costs incl. productivity). Determines currency and cost categories.

population_growth_rate.description: Annual population growth rate (e.g., 0.02 for 2%). Default 0.

name: models.budget_impact
